Spaces served: Residential, Commercial, Industrial.

### Cockroach method (4 steps)
1. Block the hideouts — gel baiting, crack-and-crevice (kitchen, drains, cabinets, bathrooms)
2. Cut the food source — drain-zone treatment and hygiene guidance
3. Destroy the colony — gel + targeted spray
4. Monitor and protect — follow-ups and warranty-backed AMC support

### Cockroach AMC plans (marketing)
- 1 Year Protection: 3 services in 12 months (every 4 months)
- 2 Year Protection: 6 services in 24 months
- Single Service: early-stage or preventive

## 5. FAQs (verbatim site answers)

**Is Pestyfi safe for kids and pets?**  
Yes. Treatments are designed to be safe for homes with children and pets when standard service instructions are followed.

**Do I need to vacate my home?**  
No. In most cases you do not need to vacate during the service.

**Do I need to remove utensils or furniture?**  
No. Experts guide you only if something specific must be moved.

**Will there be a strong chemical smell?**  
No. Treatments are 100% odourless and eco-friendly.

**How long does the treatment take?**  
Most home services complete quickly depending on property size and pest type.

**Do you offer a guarantee?**  
Yes. 365-day assured service support depending on the selected plan.

**Can I book online?**  
Yes. Book online and get 20% off on prepaid bookings: https://pestyfi.com/book/service

**What is included in the free Pestyfi Home Kit?**  
Home Kit worth ₹1,499 free with eligible prepaid bookings for everyday hygiene and pest prevention.

**Which areas do you serve?**  
Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane, and nearby areas listed in section 2.
